تلتبسي (form VIII)
# تَلْتَبِسِي (taltabisī) /tal.ta.bi.siː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# تُلْتَبَسِي (tultabasī) /tul.ta.ba.siː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
